boundaries.first_lane: metadata inventory plus per-occurrence Stored/Deflate streamed SHA-256; no extraction, password handling, decryption or execution
boundaries.verification_semantics: a member result requires EOF, observed-size agreement and decoder CRC success; declared compressed size is never reported as observed bytes
boundaries.whole_archive_coverage: one verified member does not upgrade archive traversal from partial to complete
boundaries.cross_parser_disagreement: preserve each parser's versioned result and dependency lineage; never majority-vote away disagreement
boundaries.source_race: a changed held descriptor or selected path suppresses any would-be content result
boundaries.resource_bound: read buffer 1..=1 MiB; decoder state measured separately; never claim constant memory without peak RSS evidence
boundaries.source_identity_platform_scope: Unix content verification uses device/inode/size/mode/mtime/ctime descriptor and path checks. Non-Unix content verification is explicitly Unsupported until handle-bound identity is independently qualified in #10452; metadata inventory remains best-effort.
boundaries.file_identity_claim: File identity is not content immutability, producer authenticity, or proof no malicious writer exists.
boundaries.deflate_oracle: zip 9.3.0 test-only with flate2/zlib-rs decodes the exact Deflate stream emitted by zipcore/miniz_oxide; this qualifies codec implementation diversity, not independent ZIP CRC lineage.
boundaries.crc_oracle: zipcore and zip use crc32fast 1.5.4 at the ZIP CRC layer; Symthaea's bitwise CRC known-answer test is separate but not equivalent to a fully independent end-to-end corruption oracle.
boundaries.crc_verification: A verified result requires both zipcore's decoder CRC/size EOF acceptance and Symthaea's independently implemented incremental bitwise CRC-32 matching the declared ZIP CRC. zip and zipcore still share crc32fast 1.5.4 and therefore do not count as independent ZIP CRC libraries.
boundaries.session_optimization: Current per-member decoder open preserves max_entry_size=min(caller_limit,member_declared_size). A reusable archive session may reduce repeated metadata parsing, but must retain equivalent per-member output bounds; a single global Archive ReadOptions cap is not assumed equivalent.
boundaries.zip_rs_duplicate_names: zip 9.3.0 ZipArchive metadata stores entries in a raw-name-keyed IndexMap. len/indexing is unique-name-oriented; has_duplicate_names reports raw count greater than unique map size. It is not a duplicate-occurrence oracle.
boundaries.zip64_prefixed_stub: The verifier opens a bounded virtual Read+Seek view over the same source, beginning exactly at the custom parser's admitted leading_bytes offset. The secondary decoder's heuristic offset correction is disabled; its central-directory offset is compared in ZIP-relative coordinates, and member local-header offsets are rebased to absolute carrier coordinates. The implementation and fixture are authored; exact-head tests must establish support.
boundaries.virtual_archive_slice: The decoder view is bounded to [leading_bytes, source_bytes), cannot read prefix bytes or seek past the selected file's end, and is backed by an independently opened descriptor plus a separate identity witness. It is not a copied/extracted archive.

benchmark_families.objective: Qualify whether an investigator's typed conclusion is entailed by exact, scoped, dependency-aware evidence; preserve contradictions, missing evidence, inapplicability and unknown provenance instead of turning them into confidence or majority votes.
benchmark_families.principle: Evidence does not vote; claims must be entailed within declared scope. Receipt validity, cryptographic validity, signer trust, package authorization, completeness, runtime behavior and semantic truth are distinct propositions.
benchmark_families.target: 100_percent correct disposition on the frozen finite non-implication suite; zero false entailments on explicit integrity/authenticity/completeness/signature/trust/safety controls; zero independence uplift from duplicated, relayed or unknown-lineage providers; 100_percent deterministic derivation replay for the supported claim subset.
protocol: reuse upstream Evidence, EvidenceBundle and receipt identities; do not mutate pinned REA Evidence ID semantics
freeze claim vocabulary, scope dimensions, dispositions and rule version before evaluation
require exact immutable premise references and explicit assumptions for every supported claim
preserve supports, contradictions, unknowns, unsupported and inapplicable premises; do not majority-vote
derive provider dependence only from #10410 lineage evidence; unknown ancestry is not independence
keep member integrity, archive identity, producer authenticity, signature validity, signer identity, signer trust, package authorization, platform acceptance and runtime semantics as separate claims
bind derivation receipts to evaluator commit, rule-set digest, schema digest and exact premise digests
use independent expected dispositions and rationale; generator outputs are not their own oracle
freeze a held-out adversarial suite before model evaluation and use blinded independent adjudication
compare raw synthesis, synthesis with evidence/lineage context, and synthesis gated by the typed evaluator
connect next-experiment decisions to #9911 while preserving its distinct EVSI/regret metrics
report per-predicate denominators, abstentions, missing evidence, unsupported cases and confidence intervals; no composite score
bind the canonical complete request digest into every derivation, including asserted value, source predicate, ordered evidence IDs, scope, assumptions and falsification condition
keep request schema and result schema identifiers distinct and validate both at their appropriate boundaries
do not infer lifecycle/currentness from REA Evidence v1; compose #10600 valid-time and knowledge-time projection only when source-owned evidence exists
do not infer continued validity after repository evolution; compose #10630 selective revalidation and #9112 decision-use validity
cyber claim progression and negative-evidence coverage remain owned by #2270/#453; generic provider observation support cannot promote a CyberClaim kind
for agent benchmarking separate factual accuracy, schema/field-placement accuracy, answer coverage, abstention, and grader adjudication quality
the standalone rea-claim-replay CLI must bounded-read inputs before JSON parsing and distinguish match, semantic mismatch, invalid input, IO and resource-limit outcomes through stable exit codes

a producer-supplied unkeyed SHA-256 digest is not an authenticator; recompute a forged but self-consistent derivation digest over an incorrect disposition and require independent semantic replay to reject it
compare full serialized results with RFC 8785 canonical bytes so representation-only number spelling changes do not create false replay mismatches

claim_boundaries.member_integrity: A verified member receipt supports only the exact member occurrence and decompressed bytes under its declared checks and limits.
claim_boundaries.archive_identity: A member digest is not a whole-archive digest; a whole-archive digest is not producer authenticity.
claim_boundaries.authenticity: A receipt digest or signature alone does not establish producer identity or trust; a separate attestation and trust policy are required.
claim_boundaries.signature: Cryptographic validity, signer identity, trust, package authorization and platform acceptance are separate claims.
claim_boundaries.completeness: One verified member does not establish complete archive/package traversal.
claim_boundaries.independence: Provider-name diversity or unknown ancestry does not prove independent corroboration.
claim_boundaries.semantics: Byte integrity or package signature does not establish benignness, installability, runtime behavior or control compliance.

ownership_boundaries.generic_rea_claim_evaluation: This family evaluates whether an exact provider-reported normalized observation is supported by an exact verified REA Evidence record. It is not a generic semantic truth engine.
ownership_boundaries.cyber_claim_semantics: CyberClaim families and non-laundering transitions belong to #2270; generic REA observation support cannot promote cyber claim kinds.
ownership_boundaries.lifecycle_time: Valid time, knowledge time, supersession, stale/conflict actions and source-family temporal reasoning belong to #10600.
ownership_boundaries.repository_continuity: Evidence retention, invalidation and selective revalidation across repository revisions belong to #10630.
ownership_boundaries.measurement_validity: Benchmark sampling, dependence, uncertainty and generalization remain under #6283.
